svg.text: Training-Free Test-Time Wrapper for VLA: Foveated Perception × Chunk Execution
No training, no loss, no gradients — two plug-in modules wrap a frozen, unmodified VLA backbone.
(image only — sharp fovea at the gaze, degraded periphery)
frame-diff centroid + EMA → gaze center g_t
keep ≈ 20% of full resolution (either variant, same info budget)
foveate while gripper OPEN → full-res after grasp
t+1 uses a_t+1 predicted at t —
no forward pass, no extra module
gripper open/close command (policy's own signal — no oracle)
